name: Philippine public education data (Kaggle, johnjoemmelrodelas)
covers: DepEd enrollment by grade level and senior-high track, plus teacher counts by level, for all 17 regions across 11 academic years from SY 2010-2011 to SY 2020-2021
note: Public schools only -- roughly a tenth of Philippine basic education is private and absent from every figure. Enrollment counts who is on a roll; there are no scores, no completion rates and no cohort tracking.

name: DepEd Learner Information System
covers: The originating administrative system for the enrollment and staffing counts above
note: Cited for provenance. deped.gov.ph is reachable but publishes these as spreadsheets per year rather than as a series; the Kaggle mirror is what this analysis reads.

name: UNESCO Institute for Statistics, via World Bank WDI
covers: Primary completion, gross and net enrolment ratios, out-of-school children, adult literacy, tertiary enrolment and education spending as a share of GDP, 1971-2025
note: The counterweight: DepEd counts the children who are enrolled, and these count the ones who are not. Indonesia's spending series breaks after 2015 and is marked not comparable rather than published beside the others.
